historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: through-the-cliff revenue CAGR FY2027-FY2036 of the base path (~0%) is not a usable forward proxy; 3.0% is the post-FY2031 recovery growth of the base case
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (15%) exceeds revenue CAGR (5-11%) by >30%: FY2021-FY2026 equity growth is inflated by ViiV fair-value gains through OCI (JPY274bn cumulative gain crystallised on the March 2026 reclassification) and the FY2020 J-GAAP->IFRS transition that first fair-valued the stake; it is not a compounding-rate signal. Owner-FCF CAGRs (18%) beat reported FCF because FY2021/FY2023 bases carried large intangible purchases and lower dividend receipts; none of the historical rates survive the dolutegravir cliff, which is why the paths below are built from the FY2027 guidance year and the patent calendar rather than from a CAGR.
historical_growth.notes: CAGRs on FY2021->FY2026 (5yr) and FY2023->FY2026 (3yr), all-IFRS periods. Owner-FCF series = reported FCF - intangible purchases - interest & dividends received - SBC (~JPY0.4-0.5bn): FY2021 JPY50.2bn, FY2023 JPY71.6bn, FY2026 JPY118.5bn. EPS on the post-split basis (FY2021 121.68, FY2023 207.10, FY2026 241.11).

scenario_narratives.base: A royalty annuity with a dated cliff: FY2027 guidance (JPY720bn / OP JPY230bn) is the peak-plus-one year, FY2028 grows modestly, then the dolutegravir loss of exclusivity (US compound patent Oct 2027, extensions and EU SPC into 2028-29) removes roughly JPY100-150bn of ~100%-margin royalty over FY2029-FY2031. Cabotegravir (Cabenuva/Apretude) royalties, the acquired Torii/JT and Radicava businesses, QUVIVIQ and cefiderocol rebuild revenue at ~2% from FY2032 and margins recover to ~32%. The 21.7% ViiV stake (equity-method book ~JPY643bn) and ~JPY690bn of cash, deposits and bonds sit in the bridge against JPY660bn of acquisition bridge debt, and give the equity a floor the operating flows alone do not.
scenario_narratives.bull: LAI HIV becomes the standard of care faster than the market expects, dolutegravir erosion is late and shallow, and the three FY2026 acquisitions plus IntraBio deliver a self-sustaining rare-disease/CNS franchise in the US, so the trough is shallow (~6%) and margins hold above 35%. ViiV's own profit rises as the royalty rolls off, which the book-value bridge does not credit -- upside the bull case does not even count.
scenario_narratives.bear: The cliff is a year early and steeper, cabotegravir royalties disappoint on rate and uptake, the acquired products erode (generic edaravone) while their cost base stays, and the ex-royalty business is revealed as an EBITDA-breakeven R&D organisation: FY2031 EBITDA is about a third of FY2027. The bridge assets stop the equity going to zero, but the operating business is worth little more than its net cash-like assets.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Shionogi is valued as an operating pharma company on a 10-year owner-FCF DCF with the dolutegravir royalty cliff built explicitly into the revenue and margin paths, and with every non-operating asset (21.7% ViiV Healthcare at equity-method book, time deposits and bonds, FVOCI/FVTPL securities) added once in the bridge while every income stream those assets produce (ViiV dividends and share of profit, other dividends, interest) is stripped from the flows. The royalty itself is operating revenue from Shionogi's own IP and stays in the flows; there is no double count because the royalty is ViiV's expense and the stake is a claim on ViiV's residual profit. Risk is charged in the scenario paths and weights (30/50/20), not in the 7% JPY WACC. The terminal value is capped at 15x FCF and grows at 1%.
key_risks_to_valuation: Dolutegravir loss of exclusivity timing and depth: ~JPY250bn of ~100%-margin royalty; every year earlier or 10pp steeper is worth several hundred yen per share.
Cabotegravir royalty rate and LAI uptake -- the only large offset to the cliff within the royalty line.
ViiV stake carried at equity-method book (JPY643bn, ~JPY755/share): a provisional PPA; impairment risk if ViiV's post-royalty profit disappoints, upside if valued on its ~JPY110bn/yr dividend.
JPY660bn bridge debt all current at 30 Sep 2026 -- refinancing terms in a rising JPY rate environment; IntraBio consideration undisclosed and not deducted.
Acquired-business durability: Radicava (generic IV edaravone), Torii/JT portfolio, and ~JPY60bn/yr of PPA amortisation whose tax deductibility is mixed.
Infectious-disease demand volatility (Xocova, Xofluza) and R&D at ~JPY125-130bn with a thin late-stage pipeline outside HIV.
Time deposits/bonds in the bridge are a JPY316bn roll-forward estimate pending the FY2027 yuho.

inputs.interest_income_note: FY2026 cash 'Interest and dividends received' JPY63,236m (yuho:6009) = ViiV dividends JPY52,395m (10% FVOCI stake, derecognised March 2026) + other FVOCI dividends JPY1,284m + interest on cash/time deposits/bonds. All three streams are stripped from the FCF base because every source asset is carried in the bridge (equity-method ViiV stake, FVOCI/FVTPL portfolio, cash + time deposits + bonds). From FY2027 ViiV dividends arrive as 'Dividends received from entities accounted for using equity method' inside OCF (H1 FY2027 JPY38,270m) and the share of ViiV profit (H1 JPY23,087m) is non-cash inside operating profit; neither enters the projected flows.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2026 treasury purchases JPY5m; H1 FY2027 JPY1m. No buyback programme is running (the JPY75bn FY2024 programme has lapsed and capital is going to M&A). Flat share count is a modelling convention, funded at trivial cost because SBC is 0.1% of revenue.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-30T06:30:00Z (TSE regular close 15:30 JST, Friday; 31 Oct is a Saturday)
inputs.share_count_basis: 889,632,195 issued less 38,458,657 treasury at 30 Sep 2026 (H1 FY2027 tanshin) = 851.17m, plus ~0.22m dilutive share options (FY2026 yuho diluted-EPS table) = 851.4m fully diluted; held FLAT because SBC is expensed in the flows. Post 3-for-1 split (Oct 2024).
inputs.wacc_rationale: JPY-built: 10y JGB ~1.7%, Japan ERP ~6%, beta ~0.65 for a large-cap Japanese pharma gives a CAPM cost of equity of ~5.6%; the JPY660bn bridge debt costs ~1.2% (H1 FY2027 interest paid JPY3,870m). A mechanical WACC of ~5% would capitalise the post-cliff flows too generously, so 7.0% is used: between CAPM and the house ~9% JPY keiretsu-industrial reference, reflecting a royalty-concentrated earnings base. Risk is charged ONCE: the dolutegravir patent cliff, the integration of three acquisitions and the pipeline are priced in the scenario flows and weights, not by a per-scenario WACC or an ad-hoc premium. Terminal growth 1.0% (JPY, patent-cycle business), terminal cap 15x FCF (slower, structurally cyclical cash flow).
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) leases as operating cost: FY2026 lease principal JPY4,160m (yuho:6055) + lease interest JPY341m (yuho:7707) = JPY4,501m charged inside EBITDA via lease_cost_pct_path (0.65% of revenue); lease liabilities (JPY17,304m non-current + JPY5,685m current at 30 Sep 2026) are EXCLUDED from net debt. D&A for the tax line is ex right-of-use depreciation by construction (da_pct_path calibrated to acquired-intangible amortisation + PPE depreciation).
inputs.nci_treatment: Non-controlling interests JPY554m at 30 Sep 2026 (Torii was squeezed out to 100% in Oct 2025) -- immaterial, not deducted; flows are treated as fully attributable.
inputs.tax_note: Cash taxes paid FY2026 JPY40,982m on pre-tax profit ex-dividends of ~JPY175bn = ~23%, below the ~30.6% Japanese statutory rate because of R&D tax credits and the 95% foreign-dividend exclusion. H1 FY2027 booked a one-off deferred-tax-asset recognition on US NOLs (edaravone) which lowers near-term US cash tax. Cash tax path ramps 25% -> 28% over four years and stays there; the acquired-intangible amortisation (Torii share deal is non-deductible, JT company-split and edaravone asset purchase largely deductible) is NOT perpetuated: da_pct_path declines from 12% to 6% as the PPA intangibles run off, so the D&A tax shield fades with it.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component route (SKILL.md row 2: operating company, non-US; adaptations file read -- currency, leases, NCI, matching-asset rule, SBC-near-zero all apply). Fresh build, no prior DCF, no memory entry. FY0 = FY2026 (year ended 31 Mar 2026), figures as retrospectively adjusted in the H1 FY2027 tanshin for the finalised Torii/JT/Akros PPA. Year 1 = FY2027 = company guidance revised 30 Oct 2026: revenue JPY720bn, OP JPY230bn, PBT JPY220.5bn, NPAT JPY212.5bn (H1 actual revenue JPY350.4bn, core OP JPY132.7bn, EBITDA JPY174.6bn). The 44% year-1 revenue step is the full-year consolidation of Torii Pharmaceutical + the JT pharmaceutical business (from Dec 2025) and the edaravone/RADICAVA business bought from Tanabe Pharma for JPY390.8bn on 1 Apr 2026, plus ViiV royalty growth. VIIV TREATMENT: Shionogi raised its ViiV Healthcare stake from 10% (FVOCI) to 21.7% in March 2026 (Pfizer's block, ~JPY339bn) and now equity-accounts it; book value JPY692.7bn at 31 Mar 2026 (yuho:9229; JPY353.5bn fair value of the old 10% + cost of the new 11.7%), JPY661.4bn total equity-method investments at 30 Sep 2026 (~JPY643bn ViiV after the immaterial JVs). The stake is carried in the equity bridge at that book value and its dividends (JPY52.4bn FY2026 at 10%; ~JPY110bn/yr run-rate at 21.7%, H1 FY2027 JPY38.3bn) and non-cash share of profit (H1 JPY23.1bn) are both EXCLUDED from the flows -- the matching-asset rule, charged once. The DOLUTEGRAVIR/CABOTEGRAVIR ROYALTY (FY2026 JPY261.3bn from ViiV, JPY278.6bn total incl. JT legacy royalties; ~56% of revenue and effectively ~100% of group EBITDA since R&D of JPY123bn and SG&A absorb the product gross profit) is operating revenue from Shionogi's own IP licence (fixed-percentage royalty, agreement from Oct 2012, yuho:2120) and STAYS in the flows; it has no balance-sheet asset so there is no double count with the stake. The royalty and the stake are distinct claims: the royalty is ViiV's expense, the stake is a share of ViiV's residual profit (which RISES when the royalty ends -- a partial natural hedge that the equity-method book value does not capture; memo: at 10x the ~JPY110bn dividend run-rate the stake would be worth ~JPY1.1tn, +JPY540/share vs book -- NOT taken). EBITDA margins are ex-ViiV-equity-profit (company core OP + D&A less the equity-method line): FY2026 38.8% actual; FY2027 ~38.5% implied by guidance (OP 230 + ~8 non-recurring China impairments - ~48 ViiV equity profit + ~86 D&A = ~276bn / 720bn). BRIDGE DEBT: JPY660bn bonds and borrowings, all current at 30 Sep 2026 (bridge financing for the acquisitions, to be termed out); deducted in full. Cash-like time deposits (>3m) and bonds held at amortised cost (JPY293.7bn at 31 Mar 2026, yuho:7732) are added in the bridge at a JPY316bn roll-forward estimate (+JPY88.3bn net time-deposit placements, -JPY65.8bn net investment redemptions in H1 FY2027); the FY2027 yuho will replace the estimate. PENDING: IntraBio Inc. (AQNEURSA, NPC/A-T; 2025 sales USD68m) acquisition agreed 5 Oct 2026, price undisclosed -- a committed cash outflow of probably several hundred million USD that is NOT deducted and whose revenue is only marginally in the paths. SBC 0.1% of revenue: house and street bases effectively coincide; band_position is degenerate and should be read as n/a. Working-capital capture is negative (-5% of the revenue change: receivables + inventory > payables) and releases cash in the cliff years.

bear.narrative: US generic dolutegravir arrives at the October 2027 compound-patent expiry (so the cliff lands in FY2028, a year earlier), erosion is fast across Tivicay/Triumeq/Dovato/Juluca, the cabotegravir royalty rate is lower than the DTG rate and LAI uptake slows on access/pricing; Radicava faces generic IV edaravone and a shrinking oral franchise; COVID/influenza (Xocova/Xofluza) stay subdued; Torii/JT integration and the US commercial build-out inflate SG&A while R&D stays at ~JPY130bn; the JPY660bn bridge is termed out at higher JPY rates. Revenue falls ~24% from FY2027 to FY2031 and EBITDA margin troughs at 23%, roughly a third of the FY2027 cash generation.

base.narrative: FY2027 = revised guidance JPY720bn. FY2028 still grows (ViiV LAI growth, Radicava/QUVIVIQ/Torii full-year, IntraBio) before US dolutegravir loss of exclusivity from around late calendar 2028 drives revenue down ~17% over FY2029-FY2031 as the DTG royalty (~JPY250bn peak) erodes to a cabotegravir + residual + JT legacy stream of ~JPY150-170bn. EBITDA margin falls from 39% to 30.5% because the lost royalty is ~100% margin and R&D/SG&A are only partly cut; recovery to 32.5% by FY2036 as Cabenuva/Apretude, S-365598 (twice-yearly INSTI, ~2030+), cefiderocol, Radicava and the rare-disease platform scale. D&A fades 12% -> 6% as PPA amortisation runs off.

bull.narrative: Dolutegravir erosion is later and shallower (SPC/paediatric extensions to 2029-30, Dovato two-drug regimen holds share against generic DTG combos), cabotegravir royalties compound at 25-30% as Apretude/Cabenuva and the twice-yearly formulations become the HIV standard, Radicava and AQNEURSA build a US rare-disease franchise at high margin, QUVIVIQ and the Torii portfolio deliver the domestic growth guidance implies, and ensitrelvir gets a global post-exposure-prophylaxis launch. Revenue troughs only ~6% below the FY2028 peak and margins stay above 35%.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: House default (15/50/35) moved to 30/50/20. Bear up because the thesis rests on a disclosed, dated patent cliff whose depth is unknowable from the outside, the ex-royalty business is roughly EBITDA-breakeven so downside is non-linear, and JPY660bn of acquisition debt plus an unsized IntraBio purchase arrived in the same twelve months. Bull down because it needs several independent things to go right (late LOE, cabotegravir rate/uptake, Radicava durability, rare-disease execution, ensitrelvir). The ViiV stake and cash-like assets in the bridge are why bear is not higher: they floor the equity.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
